META4.0 prepares engineers for the Industry 4.0 transition — smart manufacturing, industrial IoT, digital twins and data-driven production — across an Erasmus Mundus consortium of technical universities. Each year's call, including the exact closing date and scholarship places, is published on the programme site.

Programme Highlights

  • Industry 4.0 specialisation: IIoT, digital twins and smart production
  • Mobility across European technical universities with industry projects
  • Call-specific deadlines published annually on the official page
  • Graduates enter manufacturing digitalisation, automation and industrial data roles

Who Should Apply

Engineering graduates in mechanical, electrical, industrial and mechatronics disciplines with programming interest are the core applicants.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students per the live call.

Deadline and How to Apply

Check the META4.0 website for the current call, then submit through the consortium's application form with the requested documents. Key deadline information: Current call and closing date published on the official programme page.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About META4.0 Consortium

The META4.0 consortium delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Industry 4.0 with European technical universities and industrial partners focused on digital manufacturing.

Official website: https://www.master-meta4-0.eu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: See official page for dates - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
